say:1:1035809001:1.text: Under normal circumstances, yes. Nevertheless, golems severely damaged the portal. It will not be simple.
say:1:1035809001:1.source_cn: 正常情况下的确可以。但这一次传送门是被魔偶破坏的，恐怕...
say:1:1035809001:1.male: Under normal circumstances, yes. Nevertheless, golems severely damaged the portal. It will not be simple.
say:1:1035809001:1.female: Under normal circumstances, yes. Nevertheless, golems severely damaged the portal. It will not be simple.

say:2:1035809002:1.text: All we can do is pray for good news from the acolytes inside the Sun Temple.
say:2:1035809002:1.source_cn: 只能寄希望于日神殿内的修士们了。希望能有好消息。
